title: The City Tree That Cooled a Block
short_teaser: Urban trees provide shade, reduce heat, absorb water, and create habitat.
story: Urban trees provide shade, reduce heat, absorb water, and create habitat. A local intervention can improve several systems at once. Nature and place reveal timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of looking closely. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A local intervention can improve several systems at once. Nature and place reveal timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of looking closely.
